boundary: The finite q=3,5,7 computations are complete. The displayed all-odd-q formulas are a uniform conjectural family supported by those cases and standard rank-three geometry, not promoted here as a proved all-q theorem. Non-Desarguesian symplectic spreads remain untested.

construction.acting_group: projective symplectic similitude group generated by transvections and a nonsquare similitude
construction.objects: regular symplectic spreads in W(q,q) from one-dimensional F_(q^2)-subspaces of F_(q^2)^2

literature_boundary.not_located: A source explicitly stating the exact SRG formulas above for this regular-symplectic-spread orbit was not located in this sprint.
standard_facts_used: distinct regular spreads meet in at most q+1 lines
intersection of at least three lines is a regulus in the regular-spread setting
symplectic spreads correspond to ovoids of Q(4,q) in the standard finite-geometry framework

theorem: For the complete regular-symplectic-spread orbits at q=3,5,7, two distinct spreads meet in exactly 1 or q+1 lines, and the q+1 relation is strongly regular with parameters given by the recorded formulas. The complete orbit sizes are 36, 300, and 1176.
